zh: <title>Ely Tea Party — 给 Claude Code、Codex 的 AI 编程终端｜免费开源</title>
en: <title>Ely Tea Party — the AI coding terminal for Claude Code and Codex | Free, open source</title>

zh: Ely Tea Party 是免费开源的原生终端，把 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini、Kimi 等 coding agent 的会话变成会动的角色：谁在干活、谁在思考、谁在等你回答，一眼看清。支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。
en: Ely Tea Party is a free, open-source native terminal that turns your Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and Kimi sessions into animated characters, so you see who is working, who is thinking and who is waiting on you at a glance. For macOS, Windows and Linux.

zh: Ely Tea Party,AI 编程终端,coding agent,Claude Code,Codex,Gemini CLI,Kimi Code,OpenCode,dscode,终端,多会话管理,开源终端
en: Ely Tea Party,AI coding terminal,coding agent,Claude Code,Codex,Gemini CLI,Kimi Code,OpenCode,dscode,terminal,multiple sessions,open source terminal

zh: Ely Tea Party — 代码在跑，茶会正好。
en: Ely Tea Party — Code is running, tea is ready

zh: 给 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 们一个有温度的终端：会动的角色告诉你谁在干活、谁在等你。免费开源，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。
en: A warm terminal for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and friends: animated characters show who is working and who is waiting on you. Free and open source for macOS, Windows and Linux.

zh: Ely Tea Party：代码在跑，茶会正好。鲸鱼娘、Claude 学姐和 GPT 娘坐在一起。
en: Ely Tea Party: code is running, tea is ready. The whale girl, Claude and GPT sit together.

zh: 给 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 们一个有温度的终端。免费开源，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。
en: A warm terminal for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and friends. Free and open source for macOS, Windows and Linux.

zh: 免费开源的原生终端，把 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 等 coding agent 的会话变成会动的角色，并提供会话管理、Git、文件和活动信息。
en: A free, open-source native terminal that turns Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and other coding agent sessions into animated characters, with session management, Git, files and activity.

zh: 免费 · 开源 · macOS / Windows / Linux
en: Free · Open source · macOS / Windows / Linux

zh:
代码在跑，
茶会正好
en:
Code is running,
Tea is ready

zh:
给 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 们一个有温度的终端。
谁在干活、谁在思考、谁在等你回答——看一眼就知道。
en:
A warm, native terminal for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and friends.
Who’s working, who’s thinking, who’s waiting on you: one glance tells.

zh: macOS · Windows · Linux，免费使用，MIT 开源
en: macOS · Windows · Linux · Free to use · MIT licensed

zh: 六位 agent 角色和鲸鱼娘围坐在圆桌旁喝茶，Grok 娘在一旁弹琴，头顶显示各自的状态
en: Six agent characters and the whale girl sit around a round tea table while Grok plays guitar beside them, each with her status above her head

zh: Ely Tea Party 应用截图：左侧角色会话，中间 Codex 终端，右侧 Git、文件和用量面板
en: The Ely Tea Party app: character sessions on the left, a Codex terminal in the middle, Git, files and usage on the right

zh: 今天，谁和你一起写代码？

en: Being earnest is how she’s kind.

zh: 也可以带上你自己的小伙伴：在「设置 → 角色」导入图片或 .elyskin 形象包，替换任意角色。
en: Bring your own friends too: import an image or an .elyskin pack in Settings → Characters to replace anyone.
Pull up a chair for your next session.

zh: 打开磁盘映像，把 Ely Tea Party 拖进 Applications。已签名并完成 Apple 公证。
en: Open the disk image and drag Ely Tea Party into Applications. Signed and notarized by Apple.

zh: 解压后运行 ely-tea-party.exe。目前未签名；Windows 版暂不支持自动识别 agent 角色。
en: Unzip and run ely-tea-party.exe. Not signed yet, and the Windows build can’t detect agent characters yet.

zh: 解压后安装；需要 libxkbcommon、libxkbcommon-x11 和 libxcb。
en: Unpack and install; needs libxkbcommon, libxkbcommon-x11 and libxcb.

zh: 安装包由 Cloudflare 提供，与 GitHub Releases 一致 · 免费使用 · MIT 开源 ·
en: Downloads served by Cloudflare, identical to GitHub Releases · Free to use · MIT licensed ·

zh: 启动你熟悉的 coding agent
en: Start the coding agent you already use

zh: 这是一个新的 AI 模型吗？
en: Is this a new AI model?

zh: 不是。Ely Tea Party 是一个原生终端，你仍然使用自己的 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 等工具及其账号。Ely 把会话状态变成动画角色，并提供会话管理、Git、文件和活动信息。
en: No. Ely Tea Party is a native terminal; you keep using your own Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and other tools with their own accounts. Ely turns each session’s status into an animated character and adds session management, Git, files and activity.

zh: 需要填写 API Key 才能使用吗？
en: Do I need an API key?

zh: 可以换成自己的角色吗？
en: Can I use my own characters?

zh: 可以。在「设置 → 角色」导入 PNG、APNG、GIF、WebP 或完整的 .elyskin 形象包，也可以给不同动作配置不同动画。你能导出自己的形象包分享给朋友；网站形象市场尚未开放。
en: Yes. In Settings → Characters, import PNG, APNG, GIF or WebP images or a full .elyskin pack, with a different animation for each pose. You can export your pack to share with friends; a skin marketplace on this site isn’t open yet.

zh: 和 ELYTerminal 是什么关系？
en: How does it relate to ELYTerminal?

zh: Ely Tea Party 是获得作者许可的 ELYTerminal 分支。底层终端和原有设计来自 Zachary Zhang 与 ELYTerminal；这个分支加入了 coding agent 角色、鲸鱼娘和相关工作流。
en: Ely Tea Party is a fork of ELYTerminal, made with its author’s permission. The terminal underneath and the original design come from Zachary Zhang and ELYTerminal; this fork adds the coding agent characters, the whale girl and their workflows.

zh: 文档、表格、幻灯片、PDF、邮件、Git 和 Markdown，七款离线桌面应用
en: Seven offline desktop apps for documents, sheets, slides, PDF, mail, Git and Markdown

Open it,
and this is what you see

zh:
一个窗口，一桌 agent

左边是会话，中间是终端，右边是 Git、文件和用量。Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 们照常在里面跑，用的还是你自己的账号。
en:
One window, a table of agents

Sessions on the left, the terminal in the middle, Git, files and usage on the right. Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and friends run in it as usual, on your own accounts.

zh:
谁在干活，看一眼就知道

每个会话的 agent 是一个会动的角色，那一行写着她手上的事：
en:
See who's working at a glance

Each session's agent is an animated character, and her row names

zh: 改 src/pet/whale.rs、跑 cargo test、读 docs/architecture.md。不用挨个切进去问「好了吗」。
en: the file she's editing (src/pet/whale.rs), the command she's running (cargo test), the doc she's reading (docs/architecture.md). No more checking each tab to ask whether it's done.

zh:
等你的时候，她们会举手

Kimi 兔头上冒出红色感叹号：她在等你回答，窗口上方的鲸鱼娘也跟着举手。
en:
When they need you, they raise a hand

Kimi Bunny has a red exclamation mark over her head: she's waiting for your answer. The whale girl above the window raises her hand too.

zh: 直接跳到等你的会话；窗口在后台时，还会发系统通知。
en: jumps straight to the session that's waiting, and with the window in the background you get a system notification.

zh:
底下是一个真正的终端

真彩色、kitty 键盘协议、输入法、链接和提示符跳转都在。
en:
A real terminal underneath

Truecolor, the kitty keyboard protocol, input methods, links and prompt jumps are all there.

zh:
Git、文件和活动，就在旁边

暂存、提交、看 diff；文件树带着 Git 标记；活动时间线列出 agent 的每次提问、每个工具和用了多久。
en:
Git, files and activity beside it

Stage, commit and open diffs; the file tree carries Git's marks; the activity timeline lists each prompt, each tool the agent used and how long it took.

zh:
套餐还剩多少，心里有数

Claude Code 和 Codex 的 5 小时、本周额度，以及多久后重置，就在右栏底下，不用再去网页上查。
en:
Know what's left of your plan

Claude Code's and Codex's 5-hour and weekly windows, and when each resets, sit at the foot of the right column. No more looking it up on the web.
What's different from a plain terminal

zh: 同样跑 Claude Code、Codex，同样的 shell 和快捷键。多出来的是这些。
en: Same Claude Code and Codex, same shell and keys. Here's what you get on top.

zh: agent 在做什么切到那个标签页去看每个会话一个角色，那一行写着她正在改哪个文件、跑哪条命令
en: What an agent is doingSwitch to its tab and lookEach session has a character whose row names the file she's editing or the command she's running

zh: 有人在等你不切过去就不知道角色举手、系统通知，
en: An agent is waiting for youYou won't know until you lookShe raises a hand, a notification arrives, and

zh: 同时开很多会话一排长得一样的标签页会话栏一眼看全；
en: Many sessions at onceA row of identical tabsThe sessions column shows them all;

zh: 把所有会话摆上一张茶桌
en: seats every session at one tea table

zh: 套餐用量打开网页，或者在 agent 里问Claude Code、Codex 的额度和重置时间就在右栏
en: Plan usageOpen a web page, or ask the agentClaude Code's and Codex's windows and reset times are in the right column

zh: 关掉再打开重新 cd，重新启动 agent会话回到原来的文件夹，agent 接着之前的对话
en: Quit and reopencd back and start the agent againSessions return to their folders and agents resume their conversations

zh: 临时跑一条命令再开一个窗口
en: A quick extra commandOpen another window

zh: 在同一个文件夹拉出抽屉终端
en: opens a drawer shell in the same folder

zh: 角色识别目前支持 macOS 和 Linux；Windows 版可以正常当终端用，暂不识别 agent。快捷键以 macOS 为例，Windows 和 Linux 的对应按键在「设置 → 终端」里。
en: Characters follow agents on macOS and Linux; on Windows it works as a terminal but doesn't recognize agents yet. Keys are shown for macOS; Settings → Terminal lists Windows' and Linux's.

zh: 在「设置 → 终端 → Agent hooks」安装 hooks
en: Install hooks in Settings → Terminal → Agent hooks

zh: <small>不装 hooks 角色也会出现；装上之后状态更准，还能看到她在改哪个文件、跑哪条命令。</small>
en: <small>Characters show up without hooks too; with them, her state is exact and her row names the file she's editing or the command she's running.</small>

zh: 不需要。终端、角色，以及点鲸鱼娘弹出的任务卡，都不调用 AI，也不用填任何 Key；你的 coding agent 照常用它自己的账号登录。只有在设置里打开鲸鱼娘的 AI 解释和建议，才需要填你自己的模型服务。
en: No. The terminal, the characters and the task cards the whale girl shows when you click her use no AI and need no key, and your coding agents sign in as they always do. Only the whale girl's optional AI explanations and suggestions need a model provider of your own, set up in Settings.

zh: 这是真实的应用截图：Claude 学姐、GPT 娘和 Gemini 星在干活，Kimi 兔在等你回答，Grok 娘已经跑完。往下滚，镜头会推近每一处。
en: A real screenshot of the app: Claude Senpai, GPT-chan and Gemini Star are at work, Kimi Bunny is waiting for your answer, and Grok-chan is done. Scroll, and the view moves in on each part.

zh: 在同一个文件夹拉出抽屉终端，临时跑一条命令。退出应用再打开，每个会话会回到原来的文件夹，agent 接着之前的对话。
en: opens a drawer shell in the same folder for a quick command. Quit the app and reopen it, and every session returns to its folder, with its agent picking up the conversation.

zh: 八位老朋友，各有各的忙法。鲸鱼娘身兼两职：平时趴在窗边照看所有会话，跑 dscode 或 DeepSeek 的会话里也是她。点一个头像，看看她们平时都在干什么。
en: Eight old friends, each busy in her own way. The whale girl has two jobs: she watches over every session from the edge of the window, and she's also the one at work in dscode and DeepSeek sessions. Pick one to see what she gets up to.

zh: Ely Tea Party 的上游项目，Zachary Zhang 写的原生终端
en: The upstream project: Zachary Zhang's native terminal, where Ely Tea Party began
